doc.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well it’s been great talking with you.
Monk, it’s a pleasure to be here with you.
I think you’re going to have a good year, and I hope some of those things come true for you. It’s a beautiful piece and I’m sure the rest of the CD holds up to it also.
Oh I think you’ll like it, yeah. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
All right, thanks for your time.
